# Diagnostic ppfx01: locate execution-budget overruns without changing policy

Base `2f0f534e8311ee597e516b11c2afca1bbf608060`, bot `leader_party_tuned`. Candidate directory `bots/pi_phase-profile-01/` only. This is research instrumentation, NEVER a competitive upload. Preserve all decisions/actions and include IMPLEMENTATION.md. Do not inherit any preceding candidate.

## Primary evidence and hypothesis

Official engine3 summaries show our first100-round deaths against Fish on Swirl and Sunburst frequently follow same-actor fuelExhausted events. Swirl: Marcella20/23/25/27/29 then death29; Ren18/20/22/24 then death27. Sunburst: Heart27/29/31/33 then death34; Vesper30/32 then death35; Ren30/39/41 then death42; Vendetta27/29 then death31. Seven of eight early deaths have a preceding pause within5rounds (same-round engine ordinal checked). Fish has no first100 fuel events in these games, but Pantheon has ten in a separate Sunburst game with no early deaths: pauses are NOT proved to cause deaths. First deaths precede item purchases, so copying items does not address that opening directly.

Existing current-engine local00swirl champion-versus-C02/control games reproduce6–7 noninitial (rounds3–100) pauses with zero early deaths. They are suitable phase-profiling controls, not Fish-pressure proxies. PC holds evidence; Pi cannot independently inspect uncommitted caches.

Source suspects: observe and incoming_at repeatedly enumerate/query camps; retreat ranks nine candidate tiles and recomputes rank/incoming several times, and fight repeatedly queries ability masks. These are suspects, not established causes. Do not optimize them yet. Also do not change stale-round guards, movement, recovery, priority or other policy as part of instrumentation.

## Bounded compile-time diagnostic

Provide one clear compile-time switch default OFF. OFF builds must remove instrumentation entirely: no extra SDK calls, new runtime state, strings/logging, behavior or allocations. PC will build OFF and ON separately; document exact activation command/source flag and source hashes. Aim for OFF WASM identity with the original champion (compiler/layout can interfere, explain honestly if it does).

When enabled, instrument scoped/nested phases: World::init, observe, World::refresh, shop, choose_camp, Bot::camp_action, fight, defend_cast, move_to, retreat, and logical Bot::play_turn boundary. Minimal numeric phase IDs with parent/scope IDs, entry and exit round plus fuel. Record startFuel-endFuel only for same-round scopes; a scope spanning rounds is a crossed-round marker, never a wrapped/negative cost. Preserve exception unwinding and suspended stack semantics. Distinguish unfinished scopes at trace termination.

Use fixed bounded storage/aggregation; no strings, formatting, heap allocations or stream output inside hot scopes. Trace only first100 game rounds, optionally skip draft entirely. Emit numeric JSONL/compact parseable records prefixed PPFX only after the collection window or at a carefully documented bounded safe point. A fixed ring may aggregate older same-round samples while retaining cross-round records; report overflow/dropped counts explicitly. Avoid unbounded per-call logging. PC needs per-phase calls, same-round cost distribution (bounded histogram or retained samples), crossed-round occurrences, nesting, and start/end rounds. Nested costs are inclusive; do not sum them as exclusive totals.

At existing turn decision boundaries only, reuse already-materialized state/task/pos/health/foe-friend counts if cheap; do not add enemy visibility, ability, camp or target queries just for context. Context is optional if it would complicate/influence control flow. No action wrappers or observer calls that alter invalidation. Record movement/attack context only where already computed. First goal is reliable crossed-phase localization, not a complete replay system.

Fuel/round queries and instrumentation itself have cost. Report its design and known perturbation. Do not claim a traced match is release-performance evidence. If full tagging is too costly, support a compile-time phase mask so PC can repeat a narrower diagnostic; do not add runtime user-facing controls.

## Checks and PC protocol

Native focused tests should verify bounded storage, same-round arithmetic, cross-round accounting, parent nesting/exception exit, collection-window cutoff, overflow and OFF no-op behavior where feasible using a fake clock/fuel source. Tests must exercise actual profiler code. Do not assert the bot becomes faster or safer. Syntax-check SDK integration if available and accurately report limitations.

PC gate: review isolation and build OFF under CLI5. If OFF hash differs, compare source/engine trajectories to frozen champion before interpreting ON. ON initial fixture00swirl both sides vs C02, normal fuel only, same engine/maps/seed. Compare original and traced first100 fuel events, collection, deaths and chronology; report divergence. No80-game strength screen for this instrumentation job. If it changes behavior too much, reduce tags instead of treating shifted locations as truth.

No optimization in this job. A later independent candidate may cache one measured phase-local input or eliminate duplicated ranking work, with visibility invalidation and action timing preserved, only after the profile supports that intervention. No uploads, ranked changes, SDK edits, or changes outside the candidate.
